description: This Perl script interacts with the TestLink XML-RPC API to fetch and display project information using the getProjects method. It sets up an RPC client, sends a request with a developer key, and processes the response to print project details.

classes.name: RPC::XML::Client
classes.description: A class from the RPC::XML Perl module used to create an XML-RPC client for making remote procedure calls.

methods.name: send_request
methods.description: A method of RPC::XML::Client that sends an XML-RPC request to the server and returns the response.
